title: AnchorWeave: World-Consistent Video Generation with Retrieved Local Spatial Memories
abstract: arXiv:2602.14941v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Maintaining spatial world consistency over long horizons remains a central challenge for camera-controllable video generation. Existing memory-based approaches often condition generation on globally reconstructed 3D scenes by rendering anchor videos from the reconstructed geometry in the history. However, reconstructing a global 3D scene from multiple views inevitably introduces cross-view misalignment, as pose and depth estimation errors cause the same surfaces to be reconstructed at slightly different 3D locations across views. When fused, these inconsistencies accumulate into noisy geometry that contaminates the conditioning signals and degrades generation quality. We introduce AnchorWeave, a memory-augmented video generation framework that replaces a single misaligned global memory with multiple clean local geometric memories and learns to reconcile their cross-view inconsistencies. To this end, AnchorWeave performs coverag

translated_title: AnchorWeave：基于检索局部空间记忆的世界一致性视频生成
translated_abstract: 在长时程中保持空间世界一致性一直是相机可控视频生成的核心挑战。现有基于记忆的方法通常以全局重建的3D场景作为生成条件，即从历史帧重建的几何体中渲染锚点视频。然而，从多个视角重建全局3D场景不可避免地会引入跨视角错位问题，因为姿态和深度估计的误差会导致同一表面在不同视角下被重建到略有不同的3D位置。在融合时，这些不一致性会累积成含有噪声的几何体，从而污染条件信号并降低生成质量。我们提出了AnchorWeave，这是一个记忆增强的视频生成框架，它用多个干净的局部几何记忆取代单一错位的全局记忆，并学习调和这些记忆之间的跨视角不一致性。为此，AnchorWeave执行覆盖（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出AnchorWeave框架，用多个干净的局部几何记忆取代单一错位的全局3D重建记忆，并学习调和跨视角不一致性，从而实现长时程世界一致性的相机可控视频生成。
en_tdlr: AnchorWeave replaces a single misaligned global 3D memory with multiple clean local geometric memories and learns to reconcile their cross-view inconsistencies, enabling world-consistent camera-controllable video generation over long horizons.
